descriptions.text: KALOS: LW was hacked on May 11, 2023. This vulnerability is under the category of Rugpull cases, which, unlike other instances, were exploited by owners. A total of 6 accounts had funds forcefully drained. Vulnerable code snippet: Attack tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0xb846f3aeb9b3027fe138b23bbf41901c155bd6d4b24f08d6b83bd37a975e4e4a https://bscscan.com/tx/0x96b34dc3a98cd4055a984132d7f3f4cc5a16b2525113b8ef83c55ac0ba2b3713 Analysis: https://twitter.com/PeckShieldAlert/status/1656850634312925184 https://twitter.com/hexagate_/status/1657051084131639296 https://twitter.com/kalos_security/status/1668092799512907777
The LW token on BSC was attacked, with a loss of 48,415 USDT, and the price of LW token plummeted by 69%. The attackers have transferred about 150 BNB to Tornado Cash.

LW Token on BNB Chain was exploited via manipulation of its spot price on PancakeSwap on 12 May 2023. The attacker drained approximately $48,000 USDT-equivalent, causing the token price to plunge by around 69%. Two exploit transactions have been traced and verified on-chain. LW Token relied on its spot price from PancakeSwap as a collateral or settlement reference. This allowed an attacker to manipulate the price through flashloan-driven trades, triggering a marketing wallet buyback and inflating the token's price, then selling at the artificially high price for profit. No checks were enforced against rapid price deviation or manipulation.
